{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 2 pounds russet [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cut slightly larger than [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienne]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Neutral oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Place potatoes in a large container of clean water. Rinse repeatedly until water runs clear.
#Spin potatoes in a [[Cookbook:Salad Spinner|salad spinner]] until dry. [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Deep fry]] at 350°F until tender and limp but not browned. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#Heat oil to 375°F, and fry potatoes for 4–5 minutes.
#Drain fries on a cooling rack, and sprinkle heavily with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Serve hot.

==External links==
* [http://www.potatoes-recipes.com/french-fries Different ways of preparing french fries]
